grid.notes: Source PNG is unchanged. No visible alpha reaches any cell boundary. The generator exceeded requested80%cell size for several sprites; actual measured occupancy is recorded perframe. Runtime samples calibrated bounded frames and fits each display canvas.

rendering.method: Canvas2D runtime sampling of measured source frames, no saved cropped/resized/raster-edited derivatives.
rendering.groundPivots: Trees/shrub/grass calibrated from lower root/base pixels; cliff from base stones; palisade/gate from midpoint of oblique post-foot baseline. Each frame has its own ground pivot.
